verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an ingestion hub for choosing a standard connector by data source (docs-20), Auto Loader for cloud-storage file ingestion (docs-1, docs-13), and a partner setup guide for dbt as an ELT/transform tool (docs-10, docs-14, docs-35). However, the evidence never names specific SaaS-app or database connectors, and it does not describe their setup. Missing for 10: named SaaS app connectors (e.g., CRM/ERP sources), named database/CDC connectors, setup docs for ETL/ELT partner tools beyond dbt, independent or hands-on corroboration of connector coverage.
